answer.reason: The verses tell of Jehoiakim being set on the throne by Necho, his rebellion against Babylon, and his burning of the roll, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was made king by Pharaoh Necho, who changed his name to Jehoiakim
clauses.quote: made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father

clauses.english: rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar after serving him three years
clauses.quote: then he turned and rebelled against him

clauses.english: burned the roll containing the words of the LORD
clauses.quote: which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned

doubts: MAT 1:13 (marked) names an Eliakim in Jesus' genealogy who is a different person; left out.
Verses naming only Jehoiakim's sons, the years of Jeremiah's prophecy, and the Zedekiah comparisons were left out as not stating a deed of his.
JER 26:21-23 tells that he had Urijah the prophet fetched from Egypt and slain; left out in favour of the three chief events.
2CH 36:6 (Nebuchadnezzar binding him in fetters) is not marked and is not certain to refer to his own fate, so it was not used.
